remaining_blockers: REQ_LOSS_001 的 eligible-row normalization 在实际 loss 代码中仍不成立：binary_dice_focal 与 binary_dice_bce 对全 batch 的 dice_values 做 mean；no-T2 行虽然 mask 为 0，仍以 0 值进入 batch mean，从而稀释 T2-present edema/injury Dice。
conditional final competition 在 T2-present 与 no-T2 两个条件子组都存在时，对两个 subgroup scalar 固定等权平均；当组大小不等时，不是按实际 eligible rows/voxels 归一化。

Verifier 当前 mixed-T2/no-T2 probe 只验证 class-4 competition、edema-owned call/gradient isolation；loss semantic oracle 未验证 no-T2 行对 edema/injury loss 的不变性，也未用不等组 mixed batch 验证 conditional final competition 的 eligible-count reduction。

Stable SOURCE_SNAPSHOT 当前只绑定 5 个 implementation files，但已有 implementation_source_manifest 与 Verifier 自身 CRITICAL_SOURCE_PATHS 都把 sampler、augmentation、canonical decode/full-volume inference 等视为语义关键代码。当前 review_target 因此不会在这些语义文件变化时失效；这属于 Controller 的最小 provenance coverage gap，应在本轮重建 snapshot 时用已有 semantic source manifest/closure 修复，而不是增加 receipt hash 层。

blocking_findings.contract_clause_or_field: sections 9-10: each loss normalized by its eligible rows/voxels; no-T2 edema-exclusive losses/gradients are zero
blocking_findings.observed_violation: Both helpers build per-row Dice values and then call mean() across the complete batch. Rows with an all-zero edema_valid mask therefore contribute zero Dice values but remain in the divisor. Adding no-T2 rows changes T2-present edema_binary_dice_focal and injury_dice_bce even though those rows are ineligible.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: The frozen objective explicitly requires eligible-row normalization. This changes the effective scientific loss weighting in any mixed batch and contradicts the implementation evidence claim that eligible-row normalization is satisfied.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Average the Dice component only across rows eligible under that loss mask, while preserving the existing scientific treatment of eligible T2-present rows with empty pathology. Do not change loss weights or add new objectives.
blocking_findings.required_regression_evidence: Independent Verifier must show edema/injury unweighted loss is invariant when unchanged T2-present rows are augmented with one or more no-T2 rows.
blocking_findings.forbidden_workaround: No test-aware branch, no hard-coded batch-size correction, no fixture-ID logic, no dropping the Dice term.

blocking_findings.contract_clause_or_field: sections 9-10: T2-present six-class and no-T2 five-class competition with eligible row/voxel normalization
blocking_findings.observed_violation: The function computes one scalar for the T2-present subgroup and one scalar for the no-T2 subgroup, then uses torch.stack(final_terms).mean(). When both groups exist this forces 1:1 subgroup weighting regardless of the actual number of eligible rows/voxels.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: A 1+3 mixed batch and a 3+1 mixed batch receive the same subgroup weighting even though the frozen contract requires the loss to be normalized by the actual eligible population.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Keep the conditional class sets unchanged, but combine CE/Dice using explicit eligible voxel/row counts rather than a fixed average of subgroup means.
blocking_findings.required_regression_evidence: Independent reference oracle on an unequal mixed batch, e.g. 1 T2-present + 3 no-T2, must match the implementation.
blocking_findings.forbidden_workaround: Do not introduce a new scientific weight between complete and partial cases; this is a reduction/normalization repair only.

blocking_findings.contract_clause_or_field: sections 9-10 eligible-row normalization and section 16 independent verification
blocking_findings.observed_violation: Current mixed_t2_no_t2_batch probe verifies no-T2 graph/class competition but does not compare loss values under added ineligible rows. Current loss semantic oracle checks injury formula and Tversky semantics but does not test the eligible-row reduction or unequal conditional-group reduction, so the implementation bugs above pass the semantic Verifier.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: REQ_LOSS_001 is already frozen and verifier-authorized. Missing this mechanical oracle allows a real change in effective loss weighting to pass.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Add independent eligible-row invariance/reference probes and executed known-bad mutations for full-batch Dice dilution and fixed subgroup averaging.
blocking_findings.required_regression_evidence: Both known-bads must fail; current implementation must fail before Executor repair and pass after repair.
blocking_findings.forbidden_workaround: Do not copy or call the implementation helper as the reference calculation.

blocking_findings.observed_violation: SOURCE_SNAPSHOT implementation_critical_source currently includes only evidence builder, care_ase package init/core, care_ase_runtime and care_ase_trainer. The existing implementation_source_manifest additionally treats run scripts, evaluator, canonical decode/full-volume inference, augmentation and sampler as semantic source; Verifier tests also declare sampler/decode/full-volume critical. A change to those omitted files would not change review_target_id.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: Stable Review Snapshot is only meaningful if the one semantic digest covers the code that determines the reviewed training/inference behavior. This is a minimal content-coverage issue, not a request for more receipt hashes.
blocking_findings.required_repair: When rebuilding the snapshot after Verifier/Executor source repairs, derive the implementation semantic digest from the existing implementation_source_manifest or equivalent declared semantic source closure. Keep one digest; do not add receipt/state hashes to review_target_id.
blocking_findings.required_regression_evidence: A semantic source change in sampler or canonical inference must change review_target_id; receipt/CURRENT/doc-only changes must not.
